purpose: Add a durable, PII-free projection of Keycloak synchronization operations and their controlled retry lineage.
lockImpact: Creates one new workforce-access-owned table and validates its foreign key against the existing account directory.
dataImpact: Additive only; existing accounts and operation receipts are not rewritten.
backfill: Not required. Only synchronization Jobs submitted after deployment create projection rows.
recovery: Leave the additive table in place and forward-fix. Existing local access state remains authoritative if identity synchronization is unavailable.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed workforce-access-owned migration for later changes. Do not rewrite migration 0018.
